title: 第9章 虐杀第10章 五虎断门刀
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
然而，江辰又怎么可能让他轻易地逃出生天？
他的眼神中闪烁着冷冽的光芒，仿佛已经看穿了对方的意图。
就在这时，他屈指一弹，一抹银光在空气之中骤然闪烁了几下，犹如夜空中划过的流。
“欻！”
伴随着一声细微的破空声，那抹银光瞬间击穿了此人的大腿。
这一击，江辰并没有使出全力，但即便如此，也足以让对方失去行动能力。
“啊！”
此人惨叫一声，只感觉一股剧痛从大腿处传来，瞬间席卷全身。
他的身体不由自主地颤抖着，随后无力地倒在了地上。
他试图挣扎，但大腿上的伤口不断传来阵阵剧痛，让他根本无法站起身来。
江辰缓缓走到他的身边，居高临下地俯视着他。
“我问你答，答错了，我会让你体验一下锦衣卫的十八种酷刑。”
“是！”
他惊恐的点点头，脸上的一片慌乱之色。
“你叫什么名字？”
“我叫韩永！”
“你以前杀过多少个人？”
江辰看着他冷冷问道。
他现在迫切的想知道，罪恶值和杀人之间的关系是什么。
杀一个人会涨多少点罪恶值，是一点，还是十点。

“我，我没杀过人。”
韩永的眼神闪烁不定，试图通过狡辩来掩盖自己的罪行。
他的声音微微颤抖，显然内心充满了恐惧。
他深知自己面对的敌人非同小可，一旦落入对方手中，后果将不堪设想。
然而，江辰并没有兴趣听他的狡辩。
他冷漠地注视着韩永，不想再和韩永浪费时间，于是直接脚下一动。
下一刻，一块长剑碎片被他稳稳地捏在指尖。
这枚碎片在阳光的照耀下闪烁着寒光，仿佛蕴含着无尽的杀意。
江辰屈指一弹，只见碎片如同离弦之箭般疾射而出，速度快得惊人。
“嗖！”
伴随着一声细微的破空声，这枚长剑碎片直接划破了韩永的裤裆，深深地没入了地面。
这一击虽然并未伤及韩永的要害，但却让他吓得魂飞魄散。
他顿时感到裤裆一片湿润，脸色也变得煞白无比。
刚才就差那么一点点，韩永就感觉自己那宝贵的命根子即将永远离他而去，一股前所未有的恐惧瞬间涌上心头。
他浑身颤抖，脸色惨白如纸，汗水顺着额头不断滑落，滴落在湿润的裤裆上，更添几分狼狈。
“打偏了？”
content_en:
However, how could Jiang Chen let him escape easily?
There was a cold light in his eyes, as if he had seen through the other party's intentions.
At this moment, he flicked his finger, and a flash of silver light suddenly flashed several times in the air, like a stream passing through the night sky.
"Tian!"
Along with a subtle sound of breaking through the air, the silver light instantly penetrated the person's thigh.
In this attack, Jiang Chen did not use all his strength, but even so, it was enough to make the opponent lose the ability to move.
"Ah!"
The man screamed and felt a sharp pain coming from his thigh, instantly sweeping through his body.
His body trembled involuntarily, and then he fell to the ground weakly.
He tried to struggle, but the wound on his thigh continued to cause severe pain, making it impossible for him to stand up.
Jiang Chen slowly walked to his side and looked down at him condescendingly.
"I ask you to answer. If you get the answer wrong, I will let you experience the eighteen kinds of torture of Jinyiwei."
"Yes!"
He nodded in horror, a look of panic on his face.
"What's your name?"
"My name is Han Yong!"
"How many people have you killed before?"
Jiang Chen looked at him and asked coldly.
He now urgently wants to know what is the relationship between guilt value and murder.
How many sin points will be increased by killing a person? Is it one point or ten points?
"I, I have never killed anyone."
Han Yong's eyes flickered, trying to cover up his crime through sophistry.
His voice trembled slightly, obviously filled with fear.
He knew that the enemy he faced was no small matter, and once he fell into the hands of the opponent, the consequences would be disastrous.
However, Jiang Chen was not interested in listening to his sophistry.
He stared at Han Yong indifferently, not wanting to waste any more time with Han Yong, so he moved directly.
The next moment, a fragment of the long sword was held firmly at his fingertips.
This fragment shone coldly under the sunlight, as if it contained endless killing intent.
Jiang Chen flicked his fingers, and saw the fragments shoot out like arrows from the string, at an astonishing speed.
"Whoosh!"
With a slight sound of breaking through the air, the long sword fragment directly cut through Han Yong's crotch and sank deeply into the ground.
Although this blow did not damage Han Yong's vitals, it frightened him out of his wits.
He suddenly felt wet in his crotch, and his face became extremely pale.
Just a little bit away, Han Yong felt that his precious lifeblood was about to leave him forever, and an unprecedented fear suddenly surged into his heart.
He was shaking all over, his face was as pale as paper, and sweat kept sliding down his forehead, dripping on his wet crotch, adding to his embarrassment.
"Missed?"
